stemMd: Which statement must be true in every permitted order?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Arden and Corin must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Arden and Corin must not occupy consecutive positions.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Arden and Daro must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.

explanationMd:
Combine the ordering and placement constraints rather than assuming one example is unique. The statement "Corin must precede Arden." holds in all 2 permitted orders. Generate the cases by placing any fixed-position item and adjacent block first, then discard arrangements that violate a remaining rule. For each alternative, an explicit permitted counterexample appears in its feedback.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Eris → Corin → Bex → Daro → Arden
- Eris → Daro → Bex → Corin → Arden

distractorRationale.b: A counterexample satisfying all the rules is Eris → Daro → Bex → Corin → Arden. Thus this statement is not necessary.
distractorRationale.c: A counterexample satisfying all the rules is Eris → Daro → Bex → Corin → Arden. Thus this statement is not necessary.
distractorRationale.a: A counterexample satisfying all the rules is Eris → Corin → Bex → Daro → Arden. Thus this statement is not necessary.
